regenerate_when: openapi.yaml's components.responses or components.schemas.ErrorResponse change -- this file is an extract, not an independent source of truth.

error.code: string, e.g. INVALID_SOURCE_TYPE, TENANT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED, STALE_CURSOR, MALFORMED_CURSOR
error.message: string, user-facing; never echoes payload content or internal storage detail (HLD control I-6)

errors.name: BadRequest
errors.description: Malformed request -- includes a syntactically invalid opaque cursor value (corrupted, truncated, or tampered; distinct from 410 StaleCursor, which is a well-formed cursor that no longer resolves).

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: Credential valid but scope insufficient (e.g. data-plane token at an admin endpoint -- HLD threat E-1). Also used for TENANT_SCOPE_MISMATCH, never 404.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Resource does not exist (or is outside the caller's tenant partition -- never distinguished from true absence, to avoid a tenant-existence oracle).

errors.name: IdempotencyConflict
errors.description: Idempotency-Key reused with a different request body.

errors.name: UnprocessableEntity
errors.description: Semantically invalid -- e.g. a write with no resolvable source_type (FR-010 boundary enforcement).

errors.name: ServiceDegraded
errors.description: Read path degraded to working_only or unavailable (HLD Section 8.4); response body still returned with degraded:true where possible.

errors.name: WriteRejectedNotDurable
errors.description: Structured store unreachable; the write is rejected rather than falsely acknowledged (HLD Section 8.4 -- the one accepted single point of failure on the write path, by design, not by omission).

errors.name: StaleCursor
errors.description: The supplied cursor no longer resolves against the current assembly_id/query basis -- either it referenced a different session/assembly than the one it is now being replayed against, or the underlying result set it was issued for has expired/rotated server-side. The caller must discard the cursor and re-issue the original request without cursor to obtain a fresh first page.
